title: Warm Roasted Portuguese Chicken Roast
description: A hearty and flavorful roasted chicken dish featuring doenjang and pickles, perfect for a date night, this paleo-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together doenjang, pickle juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and place it in a roasting pan.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.
After 45 minutes, reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes.
While the chicken is roasting, prepare the pickles by chopping them into small pieces.
After the chicken has finished roasting, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving with the chopped pickles.
